{{Otheruses|Space Defense}}
A '''space defense blaster''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. They were sometimes installed as a measure of defense for [[Resort]]s owned by criminals on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Antalaha]].
